method.reviewer: AI agent (Claude Code session), single reviewer, not blind
method.summary: On 2026-11-26 one AI reviewer read up to ten rule matches per role, drawn by `python data/build_circuits.py --sample 10` and spread across sources, and judged from the name alone whether the record plausibly performs the role. Ten names per role is a rough signal, not a measured precision, and no organization was contacted or looked up.
limits: Name-only judgement; no websites or registries were opened.
Ten rows per role gives wide uncertainty.
Nine rules were tightened after a first pass; those roles were re-sampled and re-judged on the final rules.
Recall was not measured: organizations that perform a role but do not match its rule are invisible here.

self_build_program.note: Almost all matches are Habitat for Humanity affiliates; the same international filing name appears on many United States rows.

affordable_housing_developer.note: NTEE housing codes also cover housing co-ops and tenant groups.

tenant_organization.note: Only 21 release records match. Tenant unions are nearly absent from the directory.

legal_aid.note: NTEE legal-services codes include mediation and advocacy groups.

labor_union.note: United States matches are mostly joint labor-management funds filed under the labor-union code, not union locals; the directory holds almost no locals. The Wikidata union list also contains non-unions, including a learned society and a religious group.

worker_cooperative.note: Three of ten sampled rows were the same organization from different sources.

cooperative_developer.note: Membership lists of cooperative networks include ordinary co-ops and a row parsed from research prose.

workforce_training.note: NTEE employment codes and the phrase "training centre" bring in unrelated education groups.

anchor_institution.note: Weak rule. Most matches are groups attached to a hospital or university (appeals, student bodies, clinics), not the institution. Treat as a prompt to look up the institution itself.

health_outreach.note: Includes clinics and research institutes filed under public-health codes.

home_care.note: Includes support groups for unpaid family carers as well as care providers.

mutual_aid_network.note: Older fraternal and insurance-style mutual aid societies match the phrase. Most records date from 2020 and current activity is unknown.

conservation_steward.note: "Conservation trust" also names building-preservation charities, and environmental-justice groups share the NTEE codes.

energy_cooperative.note: Transition groups tagged with an energy interest are counted; they may have no generation project.

restorative_practice.note: Includes commercial arbitration chambers and family mediation.

violence_prevention.note: The youth-violence NTEE code is applied loosely in the source data.

community_media.note: Matches are almost all in Australia and Brazil.

library_or_learning.note: About seven in ten matches are Bulgarian chitalishta (community cultural centres with libraries).

school.note: The word "school" appears in many names that are not schools or school communities.
